meta.title: Delegation: refused for a user without the Approver role
gaps: Sign in as the non-Approver and attempt to delegate to a subordinate for a period, observing whether Delegation is absent or refused.
Sign in as an Approver and repeat the delegation, observing whether it is available and succeeds.
Compare the two role outcomes and determine whether tenant RBAC intentionally grants Delegation to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as the non-Approver and attempt to delegate to a subordinate for a period, observing whether Delegation is absent or refused.; Sign in as an Approver and repeat the delegation, observing whether it is available and succeeds.; Compare the two role outcomes and determine whether tenant RBAC intentionally grants Delegation to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as the non-Approver, attempt Delegation to a subordinate for a period, then repeat as an Approver in the same tenant and report whether the action is absent, refused, or succeeds for each role
